name: Cessario
summary: A sweet, gentle boy who loves to eat and sleep. Neutered, fully vaccinated, dewormed and flea-treated.
story:
We rescued Cessario in Zarqa, a city far from Amman. It is a very poor, desert area where many people don't care for animals. He had been dumped near an abandoned factory, with no food at all.

He was only about 8 months old, starving and so thin he looked like a skeleton. You can see how he looked back then in his rescue video on our Instagram.

Today Cessario is under 2 years old, healthy and very sweet. He loves to eat and to sleep. He is neutered, fully vaccinated, and we always keep his deworming and flea treatment up to date.
